steps.title: Prepare reaction mix
steps.instruction: Assemble the one‑step qRT‑PCR reaction using the SuperScript™ III Platinum™ One‑Step qRT‑PCR Kit (Life Technologies, Catalog #11732088) following the kit’s recommended component volumes and concentrations.

steps.title: Run thermal cycling
steps.instruction: Program the thermocycler with the following cycling conditions exactly as written: 50 °C for 5 min, 1 X 95 °C (initial denaturation) for 2 min, 1 X 95 °C for 3 sec, then 40 × cycles of 60 °C for 30 sec with a single fluorescence acquisition step per cycle.

steps.title: Interpret fluorescence data
steps.instruction: A satisfactory positive result must show a sigmoidal amplification curve that rises exponentially and reaches a plateau, with fluorescence intensity above that of the positive control and a clearly exceeded threshold (C_T) in the log‑linear phase. A C_T value of 40 cycles is considered negative. No‑template controls (NTCs) must not produce a curve.
